activation_blockfloat.activation_storage: raw e4m3 code = e4m3(x * 2^scale_pow2_exp); no per-activation runtime descale

exceptions.mha_out_proj: input = Score x V fp16 accumulator (NOT block-float A8); INT4 weight still shift-add (W4A16). No activation exponent for out_proj.
exceptions.qk_descale_placement: QK activation descale (2^-k applied to Q and K) must be applied on the QK accumulator BEFORE softmax (it sets logit temperature); not deferred to score x V / attention output.

activation_blockfloat.fusion_rule: final_post_acc_descale_exp = weight_APoT_exp + descale_pow2_exp(input boundary) = weight_APoT_exp - scale_pow2_exp; pure exponent offset (shift-add, no multiply)

hardware_notes: Conv/DW/MHA projection INT4 q uses qmax=7.
Conv pointwise scale groups follow the Conv2d input-channel axis, not the trailing kW axis.
INT4 APoT scales are exported as exponent/sign code files; fp16/fp32 scale files are debug views.
MHA QKV qkv_groups mask is applied after per-head quantization, matching current source behavior.
MHA in_proj compact block file stores only diagonal 64x64 Q/K/V blocks for qkv_groups=4.
BN alpha is APoT of gamma/sqrt(running_var+eps); conv bias is fused into the exported BN bias.

Decoder PW outliers (12) are PER-TENSOR SCALED FP8: stored e4m3 = fp8(w*448/amax); effective weight = e4m3_code * (amax/448). The per-tensor descale is exported (exact fp32 fp8_descale + APoT fp8_descale_apot_*) and applies once per output on the fp16 accumulator.
PReLU is exported as signed pow2. Current source uses scalar PReLU per real/imag block.
QK 1/sqrt(head_dim) is not pre-fused; metadata gives the runtime pow2 shift exponent.

ACTIVATIONS are block-float: e4m3 raw code + per-tensor shared exponent (see activation_blockfloat/). The activation enters every MAC / L-Mul as raw e4m3 code; there is NO runtime activation amax/descale. Each layer's post-acc descale = weight APoT exponent + the input boundary's descale_pow2_exp (a shift-add offset, no multiply). Because the activation scale is a single pow2, eager==fused exactly at every L-Mul site, so the validated MBSTOI (VCTK 0.8357 / TIMIT 0.7898) IS the deployed hardware number.

EXCEPTION: MHA internal out_proj input is the Score x V fp16 accumulator (W4A16, not A8); INT4 weight still shift-add. QK activation descale must be applied on the QK accumulator BEFORE softmax (logit temperature). STFT/iSTFT/complex-mask are Q1.15 DSP, outside the zero-mult core.

layers.descale_hw_note: Per-tensor descale (amax/448) factors out of the per-element L-Mul into a single scaling of the fp16 accumulator per output. To keep the core multiplier-free, realize it as a pow2/APoT exponent offset folded into L-Mul (shift-add): see fp8_descale_apot_* and HANDOFF_HW_ZERO_MULTIPLIER_CORE.md §3.4. The exact fp32 fp8_descale is the golden reference; the APoT descale is the deployable shift-add form.
layers.reconstruction: weight = e4m3_code_value * fp8_descale  (== code_value / fp8_scale, bit-exact vs module.weight)
